# Test fixtures

`nested-side-table.glb` is an original test asset generated by `npm run fixture:glb` (`scripts/make-fixture-glb.mjs`). It contains no third-party geometry, textures or product data and depicts no real product. It exists only to exercise material-preserving import:

- three separate materials: textured oak (colour + normal maps, UVs), blackened steel (metallic), clear glass (`KHR_materials_transmission`)
- four legs as instanced nodes of one mesh
- an authored root offset of (0.2, 0, -0.1) m, which import must not treat as the floor origin
- authored size 0.60 × 0.50 × 0.60 m (W × H × D, glTF metres)

It is not a demonstration of retail accuracy and must not be added to any catalog.
